summary.result: Besides, the system can make an accurate and reliable farming diary with multimedia information such as motion and sound.
summary.background: In this paper, we propose a ubiquitous Farming Diary System which can support the easy and reliable recording of a farming diary for the certificate on environment-friendly agricultural products by using the USN(Ubiquitous Sensor Network) technologies.
summary.method: By using growth-related data, the system can also control farming facilities remotely and automatically.
